arc.fallback: Past Arc: The Locus of Konoha

description.fallback: Konohamaru, Udon and Moegi ask to interview Neji about Naruto, for a report they're doing for academy students, who want to know more about Naruto. Neji hesitates, but agrees to talk with them. He tells them about what happened after he lost his fight to Naruto in the chūnin exams.

intro.fallback: Konohamaru, Udon and Moegi ask to interview Neji about Naruto, for a report they're doing for academy students, who want to know more about Naruto.
Neji hesitates, but agrees to talk with them.
He tells them about what happened after he lost his fight to Naruto in the chūnin exams.

outro.fallback: Without him, it might not even have happened.
He remembers how Hinata apologised for the trouble she caused Neji, but he told her that he did it because he wanted to, his battle with Naruto having changed him.
